sources.role: GATE chapter crosswalk and applied extensions

method: ESE contents establish the common chapter sequence. GATE contents cross-reference differently grouped chapters. Topic names and prerequisite progression are editorial study categories, not a transcription of an official syllabus. Source chapter context and question wording drive individual classification, with explicit overrides for reviewed mixed and poorly recognised entries.
ordering: Subject, chapter order, topic order, exercise form (one-mark objective, other objective, numerical, written), stable natural question ID. Year is not a sort key.
